exercises.explain: 累是原因，早睡是结果，用 so 连接。

exercises.q: The film was boring, ______ I left the cinema early.
exercises.explain: 电影无聊导致提前离开，用 so 表示结果。

exercises.q: My brother forgot his keys, ______ he couldn't enter the house.
exercises.explain: 忘带钥匙是原因，进不了门是结果。

exercises.q: The sentence 'We missed the train, so we waited for the next one.' shows a cause-and-effect relationship.
exercises.explain: 错过火车是原因，等下一班是结果。

exercises.q: He was late. He ran to school. (用 so 合并句子)
exercises.answer: He was late, so he ran to school.
exercises.explain: 迟到是原因，跑着去学校是结果。

exercises.q: I didn't have breakfast. I felt hungry at noon. (用 so 合并句子)
exercises.answer: I didn't have breakfast, so I felt hungry at noon.
exercises.explain: 没吃早饭导致中午饿，用 so 连接。

exercises.q: She was happy so she smiled.
exercises.answer: She was happy, so she smiled.
exercises.explain: so 连接两个分句时，前面通常加逗号。

exercises.q: The traffic was terrible, ______ we arrived at the airport late.
exercises.explain: 交通糟糕是原因，迟到是结果，用 so。

exercises.q: The road was icy, ______ several cars crashed.
exercises.explain: 路面结冰导致车祸，so 表示结果。

exercises.q: In the sentence 'The storm was strong, so many trees fell down.', 'so' introduces the cause.
exercises.explain: so 后面是结果，不是原因。

exercises.q: The hotel was fully booked. We stayed at a guesthouse. (用 so 合并句子)
exercises.answer: The hotel was fully booked, so we stayed at a guesthouse.
exercises.explain: 酒店订满导致住招待所，用 so 连接。

exercises.q: Because the weather was bad, so the match was postponed.
exercises.answer: The weather was bad, so the match was postponed. / Because the weather was bad, the match was postponed.
exercises.explain: because 和 so 不能同时使用，删掉其中一个。

exercises.q: He didn't wear a jacket, ______ he caught a cold.
exercises.explain: 没穿夹克导致感冒，so 引出结果。

exercises.q: The restaurant was full, ______ we decided to eat somewhere else.
exercises.explain: 餐厅满了是原因，去别处吃是结果。

exercises.q: She forgot to set her alarm, ______ she overslept.
exercises.explain: 忘设闹钟导致睡过头，用 so 连接。

exercises.q: The tickets were sold out, ______ we couldn't watch the concert.
exercises.explain: 票卖完了是原因，看不了演唱会是结果。

exercises.q: He had a headache, ______ he took some medicine.
exercises.explain: 头痛是原因，吃药是结果。

exercises.q: The museum was closed for repairs, ______ we visited the park instead.
exercises.explain: 博物馆关闭导致改去公园，用 so。

exercises.q: The sentence 'He worked hard, so he passed the exam easily.' means his hard work led to his success.
exercises.explain: 努力工作导致顺利通过考试，因果关系正确。

exercises.q: She lost her passport. She couldn't board the plane. (用 so 合并句子)
exercises.answer: She lost her passport, so she couldn't board the plane.
exercises.explain: 丢护照导致无法登机，so 引出结果。

exercises.q: The concert was cancelled. We got a refund. (用 so 合并句子)
exercises.answer: The concert was cancelled, so we got a refund.
exercises.explain: 演唱会取消导致退款，用 so 连接。

exercises.q: He was very thirsty so he drank a whole bottle of water.
exercises.answer: He was very thirsty, so he drank a whole bottle of water.
exercises.explain: so 连接两个分句时前面需要逗号。

exercises.q: The company had been losing money for years, ______ the board decided to restructure the entire organization.
exercises.explain: 长期亏损是原因，重组是结果，用 so 连接。

exercises.q: The negotiations reached a deadlock, ______ both parties agreed to bring in a mediator.
exercises.explain: 谈判陷入僵局导致双方同意引入调解人。

exercises.q: In the sentence 'The committee found the proposal lacking in detail, so they requested a full revision.', 'so' introduces the reason for the committee's decision.
exercises.explain: so 后面是结果——要求全面修改，不是原因。

exercises.q: The funding was withdrawn. The research project had to be suspended indefinitely. (用 so 合并句子)
exercises.answer: The funding was withdrawn, so the research project had to be suspended indefinitely.
exercises.explain: 资金撤回导致项目无限期暂停，用 so 连接。

exercises.q: Because the sample size was too small, so the findings were not statistically significant.
exercises.answer: The sample size was too small, so the findings were not statistically significant. / Because the sample size was too small, the findings were not statistically significant.
exercises.explain: because 和 so 不能同时使用，保留一个即可。

exercises.q: The evidence presented in court was inconclusive, ______ the jury had no choice but to acquit the defendant.
exercises.explain: 证据不足导致陪审团无罪释放，so 引出结果。

exercises.q: The government failed to address the housing crisis, ______ public discontent continued to grow.
exercises.explain: 政府未能解决危机导致公众不满加剧。

exercises.q: The experiment yielded no significant results, ______ the researchers decided to revise their methodology.
exercises.explain: 实验无显著结果导致修改方法，用 so。

exercises.q: The ancient manuscript was too fragile to handle, ______ the archivists digitized it before further study.
exercises.explain: 手稿太脆弱导致先数字化，so 表示结果。

exercises.q: The data set contained numerous outliers, ______ the statisticians applied a robust regression model.
exercises.explain: 数据有异常值导致采用稳健回归模型。

exercises.q: The bridge had developed serious structural cracks, ______ the authorities closed it to all traffic.
exercises.explain: 桥梁出现裂缝导致当局封闭交通。

exercises.q: The sentence 'The software had a critical security flaw, so the developers released an emergency patch.' indicates that the flaw caused the release of the patch.
exercises.explain: 安全漏洞导致紧急补丁发布，因果关系正确。

exercises.q: The witness's testimony contradicted the defendant's alibi. The prosecution's case collapsed. (用 so 合并句子)
exercises.answer: The witness's testimony contradicted the defendant's alibi, so the prosecution's case collapsed.
exercises.explain: 证词矛盾导致控方案件崩溃，so 引出结果。

exercises.q: The new policy was poorly communicated to the staff. Many employees misunderstood its implications. (用 so 合并句子)
exercises.answer: The new policy was poorly communicated to the staff, so many employees misunderstood its implications.
exercises.explain: 政策传达不力导致员工误解，用 so 连接。

exercises.q: The committee had not reviewed the budget carefully so it approved several unnecessary expenditures.
exercises.answer: The committee had not reviewed the budget carefully, so it approved several unnecessary expenditures.
exercises.explain: so 连接两个独立分句时，前面需要加逗号。

grammar.key: Modal Verb 'can' for Ability / 情态动词 'can' 表示能力
grammar.title: 情态动词 can 表示能力：从 can 到 could / be able to / may / might 的拓展
grammar.titleEn: Modal Verb 'can' for Ability: Extending to could / be able to / may / might
grammar.usage:
情态动词 can 表示“能力”时，核心含义是“某人具备做某事的本领、技能或客观条件”。它的基本结构为：主语 + can + 动词原形，否定形式为 cannot / can't + 动词原形，疑问形式将 can 提到主语之前。can 本身没有人称和数的变化，后面永远接动词原形，不能接 to do、doing 或过去式。

在初中阶段，can 主要用于表示现在的能力，例如“I can swim.”，以及一般性的可能性。进入高中后，需要系统掌握 can 在时间维度上的限制：can 只能表示现在或一般能力，不能直接表示过去或将来某个具体时间点上的能力。过去的能力要用 could 或 was/were able to，将来的能力要用 will be able to。其中 could 表示过去的一般能力，而 was/were able to 强调过去某一次具体场合中“成功做到了某事”，两者在语用上有明显区别。

can 与 be able to 的对比是高中语法的重要考点。can 只有现在时和过去时（could）两种形式，而 be able to 可以用于各种时态，如 have been able to、will be able to、would like to be able to 等。在表示“经过努力后成功做到”的过去事件时，只能用 was/were able to 或 managed to，不能用 could。在否定句中，couldn't 和 wasn't/weren't able to 则通常可以互换。

此外，can 表示能力时与 may / might 表示“可能性”或“许可”需要区分。can 侧重“有能力做到”，may / might 侧重“有可能发生”或“被允许”。在高中书面表达中，can 常与 be capable of doing 互换，后者更正式，适合用于议论文或说明文。

易错点一：can 后面误加 to 或使用动词的 -ing 形式。易错点二：用 can 表示过去某次具体成功做到的事，应为 was/were able to。易错点三：混淆 can 与 may 的语用功能，把“许可”写成“能力”。易错点四：在完成时或将来时中直接使用 can，应改为 be able to 的相应时态形式。
forms: 肯定式：主语 + can + 动词原形
否定式：主语 + cannot / can't + 动词原形
疑问式：Can + 主语 + 动词原形 + ...?
过去一般能力：主语 + could + 动词原形
过去具体成功：主语 + was/were able to + 动词原形
其他时态：主语 + will/have/had + be able to + 动词原形
notes: can 后面只能接动词原形，不能接 to do、doing 或过去式，这是高考语法填空和短文改错的高频失分点。
表示过去某一次具体场合中“成功做到了某事”时，书面语中优先用 was/were able to 或 managed to，避免用 could，以免被判定为语用不当。
can 没有将来时和完成时，高考写作中需要表达“将能够”或“已经能够”时，应使用 will be able to 或 have been able to。
在正式书面语中，be capable of doing 可以替换 can 表示能力，但要注意 capable 后面接 of + 动名词，不是不定式。
can 表示“能力”与 may/might 表示“可能性”在语域上有分工，高考阅读理解中常通过语境考查对二者语义差别的辨析。

examples.en: I can ride a bike without training wheels.
examples.cn: 我可以不用辅助轮骑自行车。

examples.en: She can play the piano very well, but she can't read music yet.
examples.cn: 她钢琴弹得很好，但还不识谱。

examples.en: Could you swim when you were seven years old?
examples.cn: 你七岁的时候会游泳吗？

examples.en: Although the traffic was terrible, we were able to catch the last train.
examples.cn: 尽管交通很糟糕，我们还是赶上了最后一班火车。

examples.en: By the end of this course, students will be able to write a well-structured argumentative essay.
examples.cn: 到本课程结束时，学生将能够写出结构严谨的议论文。

examples.en: Having undergone extensive training, the rescue team is capable of operating in extreme weather conditions.
examples.cn: 经过大量训练后，这支救援队能够在极端天气条件下执行任务。

exercises.q: I ______ swim very well. I learned it when I was five.
exercises.explain: can 后接动词原形表示能力，这里指现在会游泳。

exercises.q: I ______ play the piano a little.
exercises.explain: 表示会弹钢琴用 can，后接动词原形 play。

exercises.q: She cans run very fast.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 can 没有第三人称单数形式，不能说 cans。

exercises.q: I can play basketball. (改为否定句)
exercises.explain: can 的否定形式是 can't，后接动词原形。

exercises.q: My father can to cook very well.
exercises.answer: My father can cook very well.
exercises.explain: can 后必须接动词原形，不能加 to。

exercises.q: ______ you ride a bike to school?
exercises.explain: 询问能力时用 Can 开头，后接主语和动词原形。

exercises.q: My little brother ______ read yet. He is only three.
exercises.explain: can't 表示没有某种能力，后接动词原形 read。

exercises.q: Birds ______ fly high in the sky.
exercises.explain: can 表示动物天生具备的能力。

exercises.q: She ______ speak English, but she ______ speak French.
exercises.explain: can 与 can't 分别表示会与不会某种语言。

exercises.q: ______ he swim across the river?
exercises.explain: 疑问句将 Can 提到主语 he 之前。

exercises.q: They ______ come to the party tomorrow because they are busy.
exercises.explain: can't 表示因客观原因不能来。

exercises.q: Can you help me with my homework?
exercises.explain: Can 开头构成一般疑问句，表示请求或询问能力。

exercises.q: She can sing English songs. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.explain: 将 can 提到主语前构成疑问句。

exercises.q: He can't drive a car. (改为肯定句)
exercises.explain: 去掉 not，can 后接动词原形。

exercises.q: Do you can play the guitar?
exercises.explain: can 作情态动词，疑问句直接提前，不需要助动词 Do。

exercises.q: When I was young, I ______ climb tall trees easily.
exercises.explain: could 表示过去的能力，与时间状语 when I was young 一致。

exercises.q: Last night I ______ finish my homework before nine o'clock.
exercises.explain: 表示过去某次具体做成某事，常用 was able to。

exercises.q: He could to swim when he was five.
exercises.explain: could 是情态动词，后接动词原形，不能加 to。

exercises.q: He can speak French. (用 be able to 改写)
exercises.answer: He is able to speak French.
exercises.explain: can 表示现在能力时，可转换为 is able to。

exercises.q: I will can help you tomorrow.
exercises.answer: I will be able to help you tomorrow.
exercises.explain: can 不能与 will 连用，将来时需用 will be able to。

exercises.q: She ______ be able to finish the work tomorrow if she tries hard.
exercises.explain: be able to 可用于将来时，需用 will 构成 will be able to。

exercises.q: I'm sorry, but I ______ come to your party tonight.
exercises.explain: can't 表示现在不能做某事，语气直接。

exercises.q: ______ you swim when you were seven years old?
exercises.explain: 询问过去的能力用 Could，与 when you were seven 对应。

exercises.q: He ______ play the violin, but he is very good at the piano.
exercises.explain: can't 表示现在不会拉小提琴，与后半句形成对比。

exercises.q: ______ you able to come to the meeting tomorrow?
exercises.explain: be able to 的一般疑问句将 be 动词提前，主语是 you 用 Are。

exercises.q: My sister ______ speak three languages when she was only ten.
exercises.explain: could 表示过去具备的能力。

exercises.q: She wasn't able to pass the exam last year.
exercises.explain: be able to 可用于过去时，否定形式为 wasn't able to。

exercises.q: They could solve the problem. (用 be able to 改写为过去时)
exercises.answer: They were able to solve the problem.
exercises.explain: could 表示过去能力时，可转换为 were able to。

exercises.q: She can't drive a car. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.explain: 否定疑问句将 can't 提前，表示惊讶或确认。

exercises.q: She could plays the piano when she was six.
exercises.answer: She could play the piano when she was six.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 could 后接动词原形，不能加 s。

exercises.q: By the time he was ten, he ______ already read simple English stories.
exercises.explain: could 表示过去已经具备的能力，与 by the time he was ten 搭配。

exercises.q: If you try harder, you ______ achieve your goal.
exercises.explain: 条件句中用 can 表示在某种条件下能够实现目标。

exercises.q: He could have finished the work, but he chose not to.
exercises.explain: could have done 表示过去本有能力做但未做。

exercises.q: It is possible that he is at home now. (用 may 改写)
exercises.answer: He may be at home now.
exercises.explain: may be 表示对现在情况的可能性推测。

exercises.q: You mustn't be serious. You can't really mean that.
exercises.answer: You can't be serious. You can't really mean that.
exercises.explain: 表示“不可能是认真的”用 can't be，而非 mustn't be。

exercises.q: Although the exam was difficult, she ______ pass it with a high score.
exercises.explain: 表示过去某次具体成功做到某事，用 was able to 更准确。

exercises.q: You ______ be tired after such a long journey. You should rest.
exercises.explain: must 表示很有把握的推测，意为“一定”。

exercises.q: ______ I use your phone? Mine is out of battery.
exercises.explain: May I 用于礼貌地请求许可，比 Can I 更正式。

exercises.q: He ______ have gone home already, but I'm not sure.
exercises.explain: may have done 表示对过去事情的不确定推测。

exercises.q: She ______ have been at home, but nobody answered the phone.
exercises.explain: might have been 表示对过去情况的可能性推测。

exercises.q: After years of practice, he ______ speak English fluently now.
exercises.explain: can 表示经过努力后现在具备的能力。

exercises.q: She can have been a doctor, but she became a teacher instead.
exercises.explain: 表示过去本可能成为医生，应用 could have been，而非 can have been。

exercises.q: I'm sure she is tired after the long walk. (用 must 改写)
exercises.answer: She must be tired after the long walk.
exercises.explain: must be 表示对现在情况的肯定推测。

exercises.q: He was able to escape from the burning building. (用 manage to 改写)
exercises.answer: He managed to escape from the burning building.
exercises.explain: manage to do 与 was able to do 都表示过去成功做成某事。

exercises.q: He may has forgotten about the meeting.
exercises.answer: He may have forgotten about the meeting.
exercises.explain: may 后接 have done 表示对过去的推测，has 应改为 have。

exercises.q: My little sister ______ swim very well now. She practices every weekend.
exercises.explain: 句中有 now 和 every weekend，表示现在的能力，用 can。

exercises.q: My grandfather ______ (can) read without glasses when he was young.
exercises.explain: when he was young 表示过去，can 要变为 could。

exercises.q: The sentence "She cans dance very well." is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 can 后接动词原形，且没有第三人称单数变化，不能说 cans。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in negative form: I can ride a bike.
exercises.explain: can 的否定形式是 cannot 或 can't，直接加在 can 后面。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: He can sings very well.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 can 后必须接动词原形，不能用 sings。

exercises.q: ______ you help me carry this heavy box, please?
exercises.explain: 请求帮助时用 Can you...? 表示礼貌询问对方是否有能力或意愿帮忙。

exercises.q: Birds ______ fly, but fish ______.
exercises.explain: 鸟类有飞翔能力，鱼类没有，前后形成对比，用 can 和 can't。

exercises.q: I ______ hear you clearly. Please speak louder.
exercises.explain: 表示现在听不清，用 can't 表达当前能力的否定。

exercises.q: She ______ play the piano when she was five years old.
exercises.explain: 时间状语是过去时，表示过去的能力，用 could。

exercises.q: ______ you speak English? Yes, I ______.
exercises.explain: 一般疑问句将 can 提前，肯定回答用 can。

exercises.q: He ______ (not can) come to the party tomorrow because he is busy.
exercises.explain: can 的否定形式是 cannot 或 can't，表示不能。

exercises.q: In the sentence "I can swim," the word "can" is followed by the base form of the verb.
exercises.explain: can 是情态动词，后面必须接动词原形，swim 是原形。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence as a question: He can play basketball.
exercises.explain: 一般疑问句将 can 提到主语之前。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "be able to": She can finish the work today.
exercises.answer: She is able to finish the work today.
exercises.explain: can 表示现在能力时可换成 is/am/are able to。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: Do you can play the guitar?
exercises.explain: can 作情态动词构成疑问句时直接提前，不需要助动词 do。

exercises.q: After practicing for months, she ______ finally solve the math problem on her own.
exercises.explain: 强调过去经过努力后成功做到某事，用 was able to 比 could 更准确。

exercises.q: By the end of this course, you ______ (be able to) speak basic French.
exercises.explain: 将来时中表达能力要用 will be able to，can 没有将来式。

exercises.q: The sentence "He was able to escape from the fire yesterday." means he successfully escaped.
exercises.explain: was able to 在肯定句中表示过去成功做到了某事。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "be able to" in the past tense: She could solve the puzzle.
exercises.answer: She was able to solve the puzzle.
exercises.explain: 过去时中 could 表一般能力时可换成 was/were able to。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: She will can drive a car next year.
exercises.answer: She will be able to drive a car next year.
exercises.explain: can 没有将来式，将来能力用 will be able to。

exercises.q: ______ I use your phone? I need to call my mother.
exercises.explain: 请求许可时用 Can I...? 表示询问是否被允许。

exercises.q: When he was younger, he ______ run ten kilometers without stopping.
exercises.explain: 表示过去的一般能力，用 could。

exercises.q: I'm afraid I ______ attend the meeting tomorrow because I have a doctor's appointment.
exercises.explain: 表示现在或将来不能做某事，用 can't。

exercises.q: The firefighters ______ rescue the child from the burning building last night.
exercises.explain: 过去具体场合中成功完成某事，用 were able to 强调结果。

exercises.q: She ______ (not can) have said that. She wasn't even at the meeting.

grammar.key: Passive Voice with 'can be' / 含有 'can be' 的被动语态
grammar.title: 含有 can be 的被动语态（拓展：could be / may be / might be / be able to be）
grammar.titleEn: Passive Voice with 'can be' (Extended: could be / may be / might be / be able to be)
grammar.usage:
本语法点围绕“情态动词 + be + 过去分词”这一核心被动结构展开，其中最常见的是 can be + 过去分词。该结构用于表达“某事物可以被……”“某事有可能被……”，说话人关注的不是“谁去做”，而是动作本身或动作的承受者。肯定式为“主语 + can be + 过去分词”，否定式为“主语 + cannot/can't be + 过去分词”，疑问式为“Can + 主语 + be + 过去分词？”。

在高中阶段，这一结构需要从 can 拓展到其他情态动词：could be 表示过去的能力或更委婉的可能性，may be / might be 表示“也许会被……”，should be / must be 表示“应该被……”“必须被……”。此外，be able to be 也可用于被动语态，表示“能够被……”，但它在实际英语中不如 can be 常见，更多出现在较正式的书面语中。

与主动语态相比，can be 被动结构把焦点从“人”转移到“事物”。例如主动句 People can see whales off the east coast. 强调“人们能看到”，而被动句 Whales can be seen off the east coast. 强调“鲸鱼可以被看到”。当动作执行者不重要、不明确或无需提及时，被动语态更自然。

初中阶段主要要求掌握 can be + 过去分词的基本构成和主动变被动的方法；高中阶段则进一步要求：在阅读和写作中识别并运用多种情态动词的被动式，理解其语气差异，并在书面表达中恰当使用被动语态以增强客观性和正式感。

易错点一：漏掉 be 动词，写成 can seen、can used 等。易错点二：过去分词形式错误，尤其是不规则动词，如 can be took 应改为 can be taken。易错点三：混淆 can be 与 can do 的语态含义，把“能被做”误写成“能做”。易错点四：在否定句中把 not 放错位置，正确形式是 cannot be done，而不是 can be not done。
forms: 肯定式：主语 + can be + 过去分词（+ by + 动作执行者）
否定式：主语 + cannot/can't be + 过去分词
疑问式：Can + 主语 + be + 过去分词？
拓展结构：主语 + could/may/might/should/must be + 过去分词
拓展结构：主语 + be able to be + 过去分词（较正式，较少见）
主动转被动：People can do sth. → Sth. can be done (by people).
notes: 高考书面表达中，适当使用 can be / may be / should be 等被动结构可以增强文章的客观性和正式感，但不要通篇堆砌被动语态，否则会显得生硬。
注意语域差异：can be 口语和书面语都常见；be able to be 更正式，但使用频率低，写作中优先考虑 can be 或 could be。
could be 既可表示过去的能力（At that time, the data could be stored easily.），也可表示现在更委婉的可能性（The answer could be found online.），需根据上下文判断。
不规则动词的过去分词是高频失分点，如 take→taken, write→written, choose→chosen, break→broken，高考语法填空和短文改错常考。
当动作执行者不重要或不想提及时，用被动语态；但若执行者具体且重要，仍应使用主动语态，避免为了用被动而用被动。

examples.cn: 这些玩具可以放在这个盒子里。

examples.cn: 这首歌在我们学校到处都能听到。

examples.cn: 这扇坏了的窗户不容易被打开。

examples.en: Many old buildings in this area may be rebuilt in the next few years.
examples.cn: 这个地区的许多老建筑在未来几年可能会被重建。

examples.en: The results of the experiment could be affected by temperature changes.
examples.cn: 实验结果可能会受到温度变化的影响。

examples.en: Sensitive personal data must be protected under any circumstances.
examples.cn: 敏感的个人数据在任何情况下都必须受到保护。

exercises.q: The classroom ______ cleaned after school.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 can 后接动词原形 be，再接过去分词构成被动语态。

exercises.q: The homework ______ ______ finished before Friday. (用 can be 填空)
exercises.explain: 情态动词 can 加 be 构成被动语态，后接过去分词 finished。

exercises.q: The sentence "The door can opened by Tom." is correct.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 can 后必须接 be，正确形式应为 can be opened。

exercises.q: People can see whales off the east coast. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: Whales can be seen off the east coast.
exercises.explain: 主动语态宾语 whales 变为主语，谓语改为 can be seen。

exercises.q: The homework can finished by the students.
exercises.answer: The homework can be finished by the students.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 can 后缺少 be，应改为 can be finished。

exercises.q: These books ______ found in the school library.
exercises.explain: 主语 books 是复数，但情态动词 can 后固定用 be，不受主谓一致影响。

exercises.q: The song ______ sung by everyone in our class.
exercises.explain: 被动结构为 can be + 过去分词，be 不随主语变化。

exercises.q: The little cat ______ seen near the garden every morning.
exercises.explain: can be seen 表示“可能被看到”，是含有情态动词的被动语态。

exercises.q: Many stars ______ seen at night in the countryside.
exercises.explain: 主语 stars 为复数，但 can 后固定用 be 构成被动。

exercises.q: English songs ______ ______ heard in the music room. (用 can be 填空)
exercises.explain: can be heard 表示“可能被听到”，是情态动词被动结构。

exercises.q: The window ______ ______ opened on hot days. (用 can be 填空)
exercises.explain: can be opened 表示窗户“可以被打开”，强调动作的可能性。

exercises.q: The sentence "The letter can be written in English." is correct.
exercises.explain: can be written 符合“情态动词 + be + 过去分词”的被动结构。

exercises.q: The classroom cannot be cleaned after school. (改为肯定句)
exercises.answer: The classroom can be cleaned after school.
exercises.explain: 去掉否定词 not，保留情态动词被动结构。

exercises.q: The song can be sung by everyone. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Can the song be sung by everyone?
exercises.explain: 将情态动词 can 提至句首构成疑问句。

exercises.q: These trees can be plant in spring.
exercises.answer: These trees can be planted in spring.
exercises.explain: 被动语态中 plant 应用过去分词 planted。

exercises.q: The broken bike ______ repaired by my father yesterday.
exercises.explain: yesterday 表示过去时间，应用 can 的过去式 could 加 be 构成被动。

exercises.q: The problem ______ ______ solved by the teacher. (用 could be 填空)
exercises.explain: could be solved 表示过去可能被解决，是情态动词被动结构。

exercises.q: The sentence "The homework could be finished yesterday." is correct.
exercises.explain: could be finished 表示过去可能被完成，结构正确。

exercises.q: People could hear the music from the hall. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: The music could be heard from the hall.
exercises.explain: 主动语态宾语 the music 变为主语，谓语改为 could be heard。

exercises.q: The work could finished by the team yesterday.
exercises.answer: The work could be finished by the team yesterday.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 could 后缺少 be，应改为 could be finished。

exercises.q: The work ______ finished on time if we work together.
exercises.explain: 条件句表示现在或将来的可能性，用 can be + 过去分词。

exercises.q: The old photos ______ found in that box last week.
exercises.explain: last week 提示过去时间，用 could be found 表示过去可能被找到。

exercises.q: The rules ______ understood by all the students.
exercises.explain: must be understood 表示“必须被理解”，情态动词 must 后接 be 加过去分词。

exercises.q: The door ______ locked before we leave.
exercises.explain: should be locked 表示“应该被锁上”，情态动词 should 后接 be 加过去分词。

exercises.q: The lights ______ ______ turned off before midnight. (用 must be 填空)
exercises.explain: must be turned off 表示“必须被关掉”，强调义务或必要性。

exercises.q: The message ______ ______ sent by email. (用 can be 填空)
exercises.explain: can be sent 表示“可以被发送”，是情态动词被动语态。

exercises.q: The sentence "The window must opened before class." is correct.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 must 后应接 be，正确形式为 must be opened。

exercises.q: The letter can be written in Chinese. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: The letter cannot be written in Chinese.
exercises.explain: 在情态动词 can 后加 not 构成否定。

exercises.q: The rules must be followed by everyone. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Must the rules be followed by everyone?
exercises.explain: 将情态动词 must 提至句首构成疑问句。

exercises.q: The books must be return to the library on time.
exercises.answer: The books must be returned to the library on time.
exercises.explain: 被动语态中 return 应用过去分词 returned。

exercises.q: The ancient temple ______ built over 500 years ago.
exercises.explain: is said to have been built 表示“据说已经被建造”，不定式完成式强调动作已发生。

exercises.q: The new bridge ______ ______ ______ completed by the end of this year. (用 is expected to be 填空)
exercises.explain: is expected to be completed 表示“预计将被完成”，是含被动不定式的结构。

exercises.q: The sentence "The building is said to have been destroyed in the fire." is correct.
exercises.explain: is said to have been destroyed 表示“据说已经被摧毁”，结构正确。

exercises.q: People believe that the ancient city was discovered in 1920. (改为被动语态，用 is believed to have been)
exercises.answer: The ancient city is believed to have been discovered in 1920.
exercises.explain: 将宾语从句主语 the ancient city 提为主句主语，谓语改为 is believed to have been discovered。

exercises.q: The ancient city is believed to be discovered in 1920.
exercises.answer: The ancient city is believed to have been discovered in 1920.
exercises.explain: in 1920 表示过去时间，不定式应用完成式 to have been discovered。

exercises.q: The missing documents ______ found in the old cabinet.
exercises.explain: may have been found 表示对过去可能性的推测，意为“可能已经被找到”。

exercises.q: The project ______ completed by the end of next month.
exercises.explain: is expected to be completed 表示“预计将被完成”，是含不定式被动式的结构。

exercises.q: The results of the survey ______ published in the next issue.
exercises.explain: are likely to be published 表示“可能被发表”，be likely to 后接被动不定式。

exercises.q: The ancient city ______ discovered by archaeologists in 1920.
exercises.explain: is believed to have been discovered 表示“据信已经被发现”，不定式完成式表已完成的被动动作。

exercises.q: The ancient ruins ______ ______ ______ ______ discovered by accident. (用 are said to have been 填空)
exercises.explain: are said to have been discovered 表示“据说已经被发现”，不定式完成式表已完成的被动动作。

exercises.q: The final decision ______ ______ ______ made by the committee. (用 is yet to be 填空)
exercises.explain: is yet to be made 表示“尚未被做出”，yet to be done 是固定结构。

exercises.q: The sentence "The report is expected to be submitted by Friday." is correct.
exercises.explain: is expected to be submitted 表示“预计将被提交”，被动不定式使用正确。

exercises.q: The committee is expected to approve the plan. (改为被动语态，用 is expected to be approved)
exercises.answer: The plan is expected to be approved by the committee.
exercises.explain: 将主动不定式的宾语 the plan 提为主语，不定式改为被动式 to be approved。

exercises.q: People say that the temple was built over 500 years ago. (改为被动语态，用 is said to have been)
exercises.answer: The temple is said to have been built over 500 years ago.
exercises.explain: 将宾语从句主语 the temple 提为主句主语，谓语改为 is said to have been built。

exercises.q: The report is expected to be submit by Friday.
exercises.answer: The report is expected to be submitted by Friday.
exercises.explain: 被动不定式中 submit 应用过去分词 submitted。

exercises.q: The classroom ______ by the students after school.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 can 后接 be 加过去分词，构成被动语态。

exercises.q: The windows ______ (open) by the teacher.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 can 后接 be 加过去分词 opened。

exercises.q: The sentence "The door can opened by him." is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: can 后必须接 be 再加过去分词，正确形式为 can be opened。

exercises.q: People can see the stars at night. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: The stars can be seen at night.
exercises.explain: 主动语态转被动时，宾语变主语，动词用 can be + 过去分词。

exercises.q: The homework can be finish by the students.
exercises.answer: The homework can be finished by the students.
exercises.explain: finish 需用过去分词 finished 构成被动语态。

exercises.q: This song ______ on the radio every day.
exercises.explain: 被动语态结构为 can be + 过去分词，hear 的过去分词是 heard。

exercises.q: The homework ______ before Friday.
exercises.explain: can be + 过去分词表示“可以被完成”。

exercises.q: These books ______ from the library.
exercises.explain: borrow 的过去分词是 borrowed，被动结构为 can be borrowed。

exercises.q: The lights ______ off when you leave.
exercises.explain: turn off 的被动形式为 can be turned off。

exercises.q: The letter ______ (send) by email.
exercises.explain: send 的过去分词是 sent，被动结构为 can be sent。

exercises.q: The problem ______ (solve) easily.
exercises.explain: solve 的过去分词是 solved，表示“可以被解决”。

exercises.q: The sentence "The cake can be eaten by the children." is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: can be eaten 是规范的被动语态结构。

exercises.q: The floor can be washed by Tom. (改为主动语态)
exercises.explain: 被动转主动时，by 后的执行者变主语，动词恢复主动形式。

exercises.q: You can use this computer. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: This computer can be used by you.
exercises.explain: 宾语 this computer 变主语，动词用 can be used。

exercises.q: These apples can picked by the farmers.
exercises.answer: These apples can be picked by the farmers.
exercises.explain: can 后缺少 be 动词，应改为 can be picked。

exercises.q: The ancient temple ______ by tourists from all over the world.
exercises.explain: 被动结构 can be + 过去分词，visit 的过去分词是 visited。

exercises.q: The historical documents ______ (preserve) in the museum.
exercises.explain: preserve 的过去分词是 preserved，被动结构为 can be preserved。

exercises.q: The sentence "The data can be analyzed by the computer." is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: can be analyzed 是规范的被动语态结构。

exercises.q: Scientists can observe the behavior of whales in the ocean. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: The behavior of whales can be observed in the ocean by scientists.
exercises.explain: 宾语 the behavior of whales 变主语，动词用 can be observed。

exercises.q: The instructions can be wrote in simple English.
exercises.answer: The instructions can be written in simple English.
exercises.explain: write 的过去分词是 written，不是 wrote。

exercises.q: The results of the experiment ______ in the final report.
exercises.explain: include 的过去分词是 included，被动形式为 can be included。

exercises.q: These old photographs ______ carefully to avoid damage.
exercises.explain: handle 的过去分词是 handled，表示“可以被处理”。

exercises.q: The message ______ in several languages.
exercises.explain: write 的过去分词是 written，被动结构为 can be written。

exercises.q: The broken machine ______ by a professional technician.
exercises.explain: repair 的过去分词是 repaired，表示“可以被修理”。

exercises.q: The new software ______ (download) from the official website.
exercises.explain: download 的过去分词是 downloaded，表示“可以被下载”。

exercises.q: The rules ______ (explain) by the teacher before the game.
exercises.explain: explain 的过去分词是 explained，被动形式为 can be explained。

exercises.q: The sentence "The package can delivered tomorrow." is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: can 后缺少 be，正确形式为 can be delivered。

exercises.q: The old bridge can be crossed by pedestrians. (改为主动语态)
exercises.answer: Pedestrians can cross the old bridge.
exercises.explain: by 后的执行者 pedestrians 变主语，动词恢复主动形式。

exercises.q: The committee can review the application next week. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: The application can be reviewed by the committee next week.
exercises.explain: 宾语 the application 变主语，动词用 can be reviewed。

exercises.q: The tickets can be buy at the entrance.
exercises.answer: The tickets can be bought at the entrance.
exercises.explain: buy 的过去分词是 bought，被动结构为 can be bought。

exercises.q: The rare species ______ in this protected area if conservation efforts are strengthened.
exercises.explain: 被动结构 can be + 过去分词，find 的过去分词是 found。

exercises.q: The implications of the new policy ______ (analyze) from multiple perspectives.
exercises.explain: analyze 的过去分词是 analyzed，被动形式为 can be analyzed。

exercises.q: The sentence "The hypothesis can be tested through controlled experiments." is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: can be tested 是规范的被动语态结构。

grammar.key: Conditional Clause with 'if' / 条件状语从句（if）
grammar.title: if 条件状语从句：真实条件、假设条件及 unless / as long as / even if 拓展
grammar.titleEn: Conditional Clauses with if: Real and Hypothetical Conditions, with unless / as long as / even if
grammar.usage:
if 条件状语从句用来表示“在……条件下，就会发生……”。其核心结构是：if 从句提出条件，主句给出结果。根据条件性质的不同，高中阶段主要掌握真实条件句（主将从现、主情从现）和假设条件句（与现在或将来事实相反的虚拟语气）。肯定句直接用 if 引导从句；否定句可在 if 从句中用 not，也可用 unless 替换 if...not；疑问句通常对主句提问，if 从句保持陈述语序。

与近义结构对比：unless 相当于 if...not，但语气更强，强调“除非”，且不能用于虚拟语气；as long as / so long as 表示“只要”，强调唯一必要条件；even if / even though 表示“即使”，引导让步性条件，结果不受条件影响；in case 表示“以防、万一”，带有目的性，与 if 的纯粹条件不同。

初中阶段主要要求掌握“主将从现”和“主情从现”，即 if 从句用一般现在时，主句用 will/can/may 等。高中阶段则进一步要求：一是掌握 if 引导的虚拟条件句（与现在事实相反用过去时，与将来事实相反用 were to/should do）；二是理解 if 从句与主句的时态错位，如主句用 would be 而从句用 are，表示“基于现实条件的推测性结果”；三是能在书面表达中灵活使用 unless、as long as、even if 等替换 if，提升句式多样性。

易错点：1. if 从句中误用 will 表示将来，这是最常见错误；2. 混淆 if 条件句与 if 引导的宾语从句（如 I don't know if he will come 中 if 从句用将来时是正确的）；3. unless 误用于虚拟语气；4. 主句用 would 时，if 从句时态选择不当，需根据语境判断是真实条件还是虚拟条件。
forms: If + 一般现在时，主句 + will/can/may/should + 动词原形（真实条件，主将从现）
If + 一般现在时，主句 + would/could/might + 动词原形（基于现实条件的推测性结果）
If + 一般过去时，主句 + would/could/might + 动词原形（与现在事实相反的虚拟条件）
If + were to/should + 动词原形，主句 + would/could/might + 动词原形（与将来事实相反的虚拟条件）
Unless + 一般现在时，主句 + will/can + 动词原形（= If...not...）
As long as / Even if + 一般现在时，主句 + will/can + 动词原形（唯一条件 / 让步条件）
notes: if 从句中不用 will 表示将来，但 if 引导宾语从句时可以用 will，高考语法填空和短文改错常在此设陷阱。
unless 不能用于虚拟语气，不能说 Unless I were you, I would...，应改为 If I were not you...。
书面语中，if 虚拟条件句可倒装：Were I you / Should it rain / Had I known，省略 if，这是高考书面表达的高级句式。
主句用 would be 而 if 从句用 are 时，表示“基于现实条件的推测”，不是虚拟语气，注意与 If I were... 区分。
even if 与 even though 引导的从句中，时态规则与 if 条件句相同，但语义是“即使”，结果不受条件影响，语域上 even if 更偏口语，even though 更偏书面。

examples.cn: 如果附近有一些山，那对徒步旅行来说就太完美了。

examples.cn: 除非你快点，否则你会错过末班车。

examples.cn: 只要你坚持练习，你的英语口语就会稳步提高。

examples.cn: 万一明天下雨，户外典礼就不得不推迟。

exercises.q: If it ______ tomorrow, we will stay at home.
exercises.explain: if 引导的条件状语从句用一般现在时表示将来。

exercises.q: If she ______ (come) to the party, I will be very happy.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时，主语 she 是第三人称单数。

exercises.q: If it will rain tomorrow, we will stay at home.
exercises.explain: if 从句不能用 will，应改为一般现在时 rains。

exercises.q: If you don't leave now, you will be late. (改为肯定句)
exercises.answer: If you leave now, you will not be late.
exercises.explain: 将 if 从句和主句都改为肯定形式。

exercises.q: If he will come, I will tell you.
exercises.answer: If he comes, I will tell you.
exercises.explain: if 从句中不能用 will，应改为一般现在时 comes。

exercises.q: You will be late ______ you don't get up now.
exercises.explain: if 引导条件状语从句，表示“如果”。

exercises.q: If you ______ hard, you can pass the exam.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时，主语是 you，动词用原形。

exercises.q: If I have time, I ______ you tomorrow.
exercises.explain: 主句用 will 加动词原形表示将来的结果。

exercises.q: ______ you feel tired, you can have a rest.
exercises.explain: if 引导条件句，表示“如果”。

exercises.q: We will go to the park if the weather ______ (be) nice.
exercises.explain: if 条件句用一般现在时表示将来。

exercises.q: If you ______ (not hurry), you will miss the bus.
exercises.explain: if 从句的否定形式用 don't 加动词原形。

exercises.q: If you eat too much, you will feel sick.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时，主句用 will 表示结果，结构正确。

exercises.q: We will go swimming if it is sunny. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: We will not go swimming if it is not sunny.
exercises.explain: 主句和 if 从句都改为否定形式。

exercises.q: If you study hard, you will get good grades. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Will I get good grades if I study hard?
exercises.explain: 将主句改为一般疑问句，if 从句保持陈述语序。

exercises.answer: You can go out if you finish your homework.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时，不能用 will finish。

exercises.explain: 这是与现在事实相反的虚拟条件句，if 从句用过去时。

exercises.explain: 虚拟条件句中 be 动词常用 were，表示与现在事实相反。

exercises.q: If I had a million dollars, I will travel around the world.
exercises.explain: 虚拟条件句主句应用 would travel，不能用 will。

exercises.q: If you don't hurry, you will miss the train. (用 unless 改写)
exercises.answer: Unless you hurry, you will miss the train.
exercises.explain: unless 相当于 if not，后接肯定形式。

exercises.q: If I would be you, I would not do that.
exercises.answer: If I were you, I would not do that.
exercises.explain: 虚拟条件句中 be 动词用 were，不能用 would be。

exercises.q: If you ______ to the party, you will meet many old friends.
exercises.explain: 真实条件句，if 从句用一般现在时。

exercises.q: We ______ the match if it rains heavily.
exercises.explain: 主句用 will 加动词原形表示将来可能的结果。

exercises.explain: 主句可以用情态动词 can 表示建议或可能。

exercises.q: If I were you, I ______ apologize to her.
exercises.explain: 与现在事实相反的虚拟条件句，主句用 would 加动词原形。

exercises.q: If you ______ (mix) red and yellow, you get orange.
exercises.explain: 表示客观事实或普遍真理时，主从句都用一般现在时。

exercises.q: She will not come unless you ______ (invite) her.
exercises.explain: unless 相当于 if not，从句用一般现在时。

exercises.q: If you heat ice, it melts.
exercises.explain: 表示科学事实时，主从句都用一般现在时。

exercises.answer: I will not help you if you don't ask me.
exercises.explain: 主句和 if 从句都改为否定形式。

exercises.q: If you work hard, you will succeed. (用 can 改写主句)
exercises.answer: If you work hard, you can succeed.
exercises.explain: 主句可以用情态动词 can 表示可能性。

exercises.q: If it will snow tomorrow, we will make a snowman.
exercises.answer: If it snows tomorrow, we will make a snowman.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时，不能用 will snow。

exercises.explain: 与过去事实相反的虚拟条件句，主句用 would have done。

exercises.q: If I had known about the traffic jam, I would have left earlier.
exercises.explain: 与过去事实相反的虚拟条件句，结构正确。

exercises.q: If you don't water the plants, they will die. (用 unless 改写)
exercises.answer: Unless you water the plants, they will die.
exercises.explain: unless 相当于 if not，后接肯定形式。

exercises.q: If I would have known, I would have told you.
exercises.answer: If I had known, I would have told you.
exercises.explain: if 从句中不能用 would have known，应改为 had known。

exercises.q: ______ he arrives late, the meeting will be delayed.
exercises.explain: if 引导条件状语从句，表示“如果”。

exercises.q: If I ______ the answer, I would tell you now.
exercises.explain: 与现在事实相反的虚拟条件句，if 从句用过去时。

exercises.q: You can borrow my car ______ you promise to drive carefully.
exercises.explain: as long as 表示“只要”，引导条件状语从句。

exercises.q: If it ______ not for your help, I would have failed.
exercises.explain: 与过去事实相反的虚拟条件句，if 从句用过去完成时。

exercises.explain: provided that 表示“如果，只要”，引导条件状语从句。

exercises.explain: suppose 可以引导条件句，表示“假设”。

exercises.explain: 真实条件句 if 从句不能用 will，主句也不应用 would。

exercises.q: I would have called you if I had known you were home. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: I would not have called you if I had not known you were home.
exercises.explain: 主句和 if 从句都改为否定形式。

exercises.q: If you heat water to 100 degrees, it boils. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Does water boil if you heat it to 100 degrees?
exercises.explain: 将主句改为一般疑问句，if 从句保持陈述语序。

exercises.q: Unless you don't study hard, you will fail the exam.
exercises.answer: Unless you study hard, you will fail the exam.
exercises.explain: unless 本身已含否定意义，不能再加 don't。

exercises.q: If it ______ tomorrow, we will stay at home.
exercises.explain: if 条件句表示将来可能时，从句用一般现在时，不用 will。

exercises.q: If she ______ (come) to the party, I will be very happy.
exercises.explain: if 条件句从句用一般现在时，主语 she 为第三人称单数。

exercises.q: If it will rain tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic.
exercises.explain: if 条件句中不能用 will，应用一般现在时 rains。

exercises.q: If you don't hurry, you will miss the train. (改为肯定句)
options: If you hurry, you will catch the train.
exercises.answer: If you hurry, you will catch the train.
exercises.explain: 将否定条件改为肯定条件，主句结果也相应变为肯定。

exercises.q: If you will come to my house, I will show you my new computer.
options: If you come to my house, I will show you my new computer.
exercises.answer: If you come to my house, I will show you my new computer.
exercises.explain: if 条件句中不能用 will，应改为一般现在时 come。

exercises.q: You will miss the bus ______ you hurry up.
exercises.explain: unless 表示“除非”，相当于 if not，符合句意。

exercises.q: If you ______ harder, you can pass the exam.

exercises.q: ______ you feel tired, you should take a rest.
exercises.explain: if 引导条件状语从句，表示“如果”。

exercises.q: We will go to the park if the weather ______ nice.
exercises.explain: if 条件句主将从现，从句用一般现在时。

exercises.q: You can borrow my book if you ______ (return) it tomorrow.
exercises.explain: 主句有情态动词 can，if 从句用一般现在时。

exercises.q: If he ______ (not hurry), he will be late for school.
exercises.explain: if 条件句否定形式用 doesn't + 动词原形。

exercises.q: If you heat ice, it melts.
exercises.explain: 这是零条件句，表示科学事实，主从句都用一般现在时。

exercises.q: We will go swimming. The weather is fine. (用 if 合并句子)
options: We will go swimming if the weather is fine.
exercises.answer: We will go swimming if the weather is fine.
exercises.explain: 用 if 连接条件与结果，注意主将从现。

exercises.q: If you eat too much, you will get fat. (改为一般疑问句)
options: Will I get fat if I eat too much?
exercises.answer: Will I get fat if I eat too much?
exercises.explain: 将主句改为一般疑问句，if 从句保持陈述语序。

exercises.q: She will be happy if she gets the gift.
options: She will be happy if she gets the gift.
exercises.answer: She will be happy if she gets the gift.
exercises.explain: 原句正确，if 从句用一般现在时，主句用将来时。

exercises.q: If I ______ enough money, I would buy a new bike.
exercises.explain: 这是第二条件句，表示与现在事实相反的假设，if 从句用过去时。

exercises.q: If I ______ (be) you, I would accept the offer.
exercises.explain: 虚拟语气中 if 从句的 be 动词用 were，表示与现在事实相反。

exercises.q: If I would have known about the traffic, I would have left earlier.
exercises.explain: 第三条件句 if 从句应用 had known，不能用 would have known。

exercises.q: I don't have enough time, so I can't help you. (用 if 改写为虚拟语气)
options: If I had enough time, I could help you.
exercises.answer: If I had enough time, I could help you.
exercises.explain: 第二条件句表示与现在事实相反，if 从句用过去时，主句用 could。

exercises.q: If I was you, I would take that job.
options: If I were you, I would take that job.
exercises.answer: If I were you, I would take that job.
exercises.explain: 虚拟语气中 if I were 是固定表达，不用 was。

exercises.q: You won't improve your English ______ you practice speaking every day.

exercises.q: ______ I were you, I would apologize to her.

exercises.q: If you ______ the instructions carefully, you wouldn't have made this mistake.
exercises.explain: 第三条件句 if 从句用过去完成时 had read。

exercises.q: She would have come to the party if she ______ (know) about it.
exercises.explain: 第三条件句 if 从句用过去完成时 had known。

exercises.q: If he were taller, he could join the basketball team.

exercises.q: He didn't study hard, so he failed the exam. (用 if 改写为虚拟语气)

exercises.explain: 第三条件句主句应用 would have helped，与过去事实相反。

grammar.key: Present Perfect Tense / 现在完成时
grammar.title: 现在完成时：从“经历”到“影响”的完整用法（含 ever / never / already / yet / since / for）
grammar.titleEn: Present Perfect Tense: Experiences, Results and Duration
grammar.usage:
现在完成时的核心结构是“have/has + 过去分词”。它主要用于表达过去发生的动作或状态与现在存在某种联系，常见有三类用法：一是表示“曾经有过的经历”，常与 ever、never 搭配，强调“到目前为止是否有过某种经历”，但并不说明具体发生时间；二是表示“已经完成的动作对现在造成的影响或结果”，常与 already、just、yet 搭配；三是表示“从过去持续到现在的动作或状态”，常与 since、for、so far、up to now 等连用。

肯定句结构为“主语 + have/has + 过去分词”，否定句在 have/has 后加 not，疑问句将 have/has 提前。例如：I have seen that film.（我看过那部电影。）She has not finished her work yet.（她还没完成工作。）Have you ever tried Japanese food?（你尝过日本料理吗？）

现在完成时与一般过去时是高中阶段最容易混淆的一组时态。一般过去时强调动作发生在过去的具体时间，常与 yesterday、last week、in 2019、two days ago 等明确的过去时间状语连用；而现在完成时不关注动作发生的具体时间，关注的是“与现在的联系”。例如：I saw the film yesterday.（我昨天看了那部电影。）I have seen the film before.（我以前看过那部电影。）

初中阶段通常只要求掌握 have/has + 过去分词的基本形式以及 ever、never、already、yet 的简单用法；高中阶段则进一步要求理解现在完成时与一般过去时在语境中的切换、现在完成进行时的区别、以及 have been to / have gone to / have been in 的辨析。此外，高中书面表达中常要求用现在完成时表达“近年来发生的变化”，如“In recent years, great changes have taken place in my hometown.”

易错点一：把现在完成时与具体过去时间连用。不能说“I have seen him yesterday”，应改为“I saw him yesterday”或“I have seen him before”。易错点二：have been to 与 have gone to 混淆。have been to 表示“去过某地（已回来）”，have gone to 表示“去了某地（还没回来）”。易错点三：since 后面接时间点，for 后面接时间段，两者不可混用。易错点四：短暂性动词（如 come、go、leave、buy、die）在现在完成时中不能与表示一段时间的状语连用，需转换为延续性表达，如“He has been away for two years”而非“He has left for two years”。
forms: 肯定句：主语 + have/has + 过去分词（V-ed/V3）
否定句：主语 + have/has + not + 过去分词（haven't / hasn't）
一般疑问句：Have/Has + 主语 + 过去分词 + 其他？
特殊疑问句：疑问词 + have/has + 主语 + 过去分词 + 其他？
have been to + 地点：去过某地（已回来）；have gone to + 地点：去了某地（未回来）
since + 时间点 / 从句；for + 时间段
notes: 高考书面表达中，描述“近年来变化”或“到目前为止的成就”时，优先考虑现在完成时，如“So far, we have made great progress.”
注意语域差异：口语中常省略 have/has，如“You seen it?”，但书面语和考试中必须完整写出 have/has。
already 多用于肯定句，yet 多用于否定句和疑问句；just 表示“刚刚”，强调动作刚发生不久。
短暂性动词（die、leave、buy、join、come 等）不能与 for + 时间段连用，需改为延续性表达或使用“It has been + 时间段 + since + 一般过去时”结构。
在 since 引导的时间状语从句中，主句用现在完成时，从句通常用一般过去时，如“I have known him since he moved here.”

grammar.key: Modal Verb for Suggestion/Offer: 'can' / 情态动词表示建议/提供：'can'
grammar.title: 情态动词 can 表示建议、提供与可能性（拓展：could / be able to / may / might）
grammar.titleEn: Modal Verb 'can' for Suggestions, Offers and Possibility (Extended: could / be able to / may / might)
grammar.usage:
情态动词 can 除了表示“能力”之外，在高中阶段更常见的是用来表示“建议、提供、可能性或服务功能”。它的核心结构是：主语 + can + 动词原形。肯定句中，can 表示“可以、能够、有机会做某事”；否定句用 cannot / can't，表示“不可以、不能、没有条件做某事”；疑问句把 can 提到主语前，构成 Can + 主语 + 动词原形？，常用于提出建议或主动提供帮助，如 Can I help you? / Can I give you a suggestion?。

在表示“建议”时，can 的语气比 should 更委婉、更开放，它不带有“应该做”的义务感，而是给出一个可选项。例如 You can stay in our resort 表示“您可以选择住在我们的度假村”，而不是“您必须住”或“您应该住”。在广告、旅游宣传、产品说明等文本中，can 常用来介绍服务或功能，相当于“我们提供……”“您可以享受……”。

与近义结构对比：could 是 can 的过去式，但在表示建议时，could 比 can 更委婉、更不确定，如 You could try this one（您可以试试这个，语气更柔和）。may / might 也可以表示“可以”，但 may 更正式，常用于书面语或正式场合，might 则语气最弱，表示可能性较低或建议更不直接。be able to 则主要强调“能力”，不用于表示建议或提供服务，如 You are able to use the gym 强调“你有能力使用健身房”，而 You can use the gym 更自然地表示“你可以使用健身房（我们提供这个设施）”。

初中阶段，学生主要掌握 can 表示“能力”和“请求许可”的用法，如 I can swim. / Can I go now?。高中阶段则要进一步理解 can 在语境中的“建议、提供、宣传功能”，尤其是阅读理解中广告类、说明类文本里 can 的含义。高考完形填空和阅读理解中，can 常与 service、facility、option、possibility 等词共现，需要根据上下文判断它是否表示“提供”而非“能力”。

易错点一：把 can 一律翻译成“能”，忽略它在宣传文本中表示“提供、可选择”的含义。易错点二：在正式书面语中过度使用 can 表示建议，而不知道 could / may 更符合语域要求。易错点三：混淆 can 和 be able to 的语用区别，在表示“提供某项服务”时误用 be able to。易错点四：否定句中 can't 表示“不可以”时，容易与 mustn't（禁止）混淆，can't 语气较轻，表示“不能、不允许”，而 mustn't 表示“严禁、绝对不可以”。
forms: 主语 + can + 动词原形（表示建议/提供/可能性）
主语 + cannot / can't + 动词原形（表示不可以/不能/没有条件）
Can + 主语 + 动词原形？（表示提出建议或主动提供）
主语 + could + 动词原形（比 can 更委婉的建议）
主语 + may / might + 动词原形（更正式或更不确定的建议）
主语 + be able to + 动词原形（仅表能力，不表建议/提供）
notes: 高考阅读理解中，can 在广告、旅游、产品介绍里常表示“提供、可享受”，不要只按“能”来理解，要结合 facility、service、option 等词判断。
书面语中提出建议时，could 比 can 更委婉，may 更正式。高考写作中建议使用 could 或 may 来提升语域，避免通篇 can。
can 表示“提供”时，主语常是 you 或 visitors / guests / customers 等，表示对方可以享受某项服务，而不是主语本身具备能力。
否定句中 can't 表示“不可以、不能”，语气比 mustn't 轻。高考语法填空或改错中要区分 can't（不允许/不能）和 mustn't（严禁）。
be able to 不能替代 can 表示“建议”或“提供”。例如不能说 You are able to enjoy free breakfast（语用错误），应说 You can enjoy free breakfast。

grammar.title: 一般将来时 will 表示承诺与即时决定（含 if 条件句、be going to 对比）
grammar.titleEn: Future Simple with 'will' for Promises and Instant Decisions
grammar.usage:
核心结构：will + 动词原形，适用于说话当下做出的承诺、即时决定或对未来的确定性宣告。肯定句为“主语 + will + 动词原形”，否定句在 will 后加 not，可缩写为 won't；一般疑问句将 will 提到主语前，特殊疑问句用“疑问词 + will + 主语 + 动词原形”。

与 be going to 的核心区别：will 强调说话瞬间才做出的决定或承诺，没有事先计划；be going to 则强调事先已有打算或已有迹象表明某事将要发生。例如听到门铃响时说“I'll get it.”是即时决定，而“I'm going to visit my grandparents this weekend.”是事先计划。

在 if 引导的第一条件句中，主句常用 will 表示在某个条件下必然发生的结果或承诺，结构为“If + 一般现在时, 主语 + will + 动词原形”。此时 will 不表示“意愿”，而是表达一种确定性的未来结果。

初中阶段主要要求掌握 will 表示一般将来时的基本用法，能写出肯定、否定和疑问句；高中阶段则要求在服务场景、商务沟通和书面表达中准确区分 will 与 be going to，理解 will 在条件句中的“确定性结果”功能，并能识别 will 表示“意愿、承诺、即时决定”的语用含义。

易错点：一是在 if 条件句的条件部分误用 will，如“If it will rain”是错误的，条件部分必须用一般现在时；二是把事先计划好的事情误用 will 表达，如已经买好票的旅行应说“I'm going to travel”，而非“I will travel”；三是忽略 will 在服务语境中的承诺功能，把它简单理解为“将要”；四是在正式书面语中过度使用 will 的缩写形式，高考书面表达中应根据语域适当使用完整形式。
forms: 肯定句：主语 + will + 动词原形
否定句：主语 + will not (won't) + 动词原形
一般疑问句：Will + 主语 + 动词原形?
特殊疑问句：疑问词 + will + 主语 + 动词原形?
第一条件句：If + 一般现在时, 主语 + will + 动词原形
对比结构：will（即时决定/承诺） vs be going to（事先计划）
notes: 高考书面表达中，服务场景或正式承诺建议使用完整形式“we will”，避免过度使用缩写“we'll”，以体现语域的正式性。
if 条件句的条件部分绝不能用 will，必须用一般现在时；will 只出现在主句中。
will 表示“意愿”时，主语通常是人；表示“承诺”时，常见于第一人称或服务方（如 we will send...）。
在高考阅读理解中，遇到“I'll take it.”“I'll answer it.”等句子，要识别这是说话当下的即时决定，而非事先计划。
be going to 与 will 的选择题中，若题干出现“already”“planned”“look at the clouds”等提示词，通常选 be going to；若出现“I think”“maybe”“just decided”等，通常选 will。

grammar.key: Inversion for Emphasis: 'Nowhere else can you...' / 倒装句表示强调：'Nowhere else can you...'
grammar.title: 否定副词置于句首的倒装结构：从 nowhere else 到 never / seldom / hardly / not only
grammar.titleEn: Inversion for Emphasis: Negative Adverbs at the Beginning (nowhere else / never / seldom / hardly / not only)
grammar.usage:
核心结构：当表示否定或限制意义的副词或副词短语（如 nowhere else、never、seldom、hardly、little、not only、no sooner 等）被置于句首以加强语气时，句子需要采用部分倒装语序，即把助动词、情态动词或 be 动词提到主语之前，构成“否定副词 + 助动词/情态动词/be + 主语 + 谓语动词”的结构。例如正常语序“You can find nowhere else a better place”在强调时变为“Nowhere else can you find a better place”。

肯定、否定与疑问形式：该结构本身表达否定或限制意义，因此句子在语义上是否定的，但形式上不需要再加 not。疑问形式通常不直接用于该倒装结构，因为倒装本身已经改变了语序；若需提问，一般回归正常语序或使用其他句式。

与近义结构对比：倒装结构与“It is... that...”强调句不同。强调句可以强调主语、宾语、状语等多种成分，而否定副词倒装主要强调状语或否定意义本身。与“only + 状语”位于句首的倒装相比，否定副词倒装的触发词范围更广，且语气更强烈。与正常语序相比，倒装结构更正式、更具文学色彩和强调效果。

初中用法 vs 高中用法：初中阶段主要接触“Never give up”这类祈使句或简单否定句，较少系统学习倒装。高中阶段则要求掌握否定副词置于句首时的部分倒装规则，并能在书面表达中有意识地运用以提升文采和正式度。高考中常以语法填空、短文改错和写作升级等形式考查。

易错点：1）只把否定副词提前而不倒装，例如“Never I have seen such a sunset”是错误的；2）混淆完全倒装和部分倒装，否定副词置于句首时通常用部分倒装，而不是把整个谓语动词提前；3）not only... but also... 连接两个分句时，not only 所在的分句要倒装，but also 后的分句不倒装；4）hardly... when... 和 no sooner... than... 结构中，主句用过去完成时并倒装，从句用一般过去时，时态搭配容易出错。
forms: 否定副词/短语 + 助动词/情态动词/be + 主语 + 谓语动词 + 其他（Nowhere else can you find such a view.）
Never + have/has/had + 主语 + 过去分词（Never have I seen such a sunset.）
Seldom/Rarely + do/does/did + 主语 + 动词原形（Seldom does he arrive on time.）
Hardly + had + 主语 + 过去分词 + when + 从句（一般过去时）（Hardly had I arrived when it began to rain.）
Not only + 助动词/情态动词/be + 主语 + 谓语动词 + but also + 正常语序（Not only did he pass the exam, but he also got the highest score.）
Little + do/does/did + 主语 + 动词原形（Little did we know the truth at that time.）
notes: 否定副词置于句首时，必须进行部分倒装，不能只提前副词而保持正常语序。
注意区分完全倒装和部分倒装：否定副词倒装属于部分倒装，只把助动词、情态动词或 be 动词提前，谓语动词的其余部分仍在主语之后。
not only... but also... 结构中，只有 not only 所在的分句倒装，but also 后的分句保持正常语序，高考常在此处设空。
hardly... when... 和 no sooner... than... 结构中，主句用过去完成时并倒装，从句用一般过去时，时态搭配是高考高频失分点。
在书面语和正式文体中，适当使用否定副词倒装可以增强语气和文采，但不宜在口语或非正式写作中过度使用，以免显得生硬。

grammar.key: Gerund as Object of Preposition: 'interested in hiking' / 动名词作介词宾语：'interested in hiking'
grammar.title: 动名词作介词宾语：interested in hiking 及常见介词搭配拓展
grammar.titleEn: Gerund as Object of Preposition: 'interested in hiking' and Common Prepositional Patterns
grammar.usage:
动名词是动词的-ing形式，在句中起名词作用。当它出现在介词后面时，必须使用动名词形式，而不能用动词不定式。核心结构为“介词 + 动名词”，例如 interested in hiking、good at drawing、afraid of flying。这一规则适用于所有介词，包括 in、at、on、of、about、with、without、for、from、to（当 to 为介词时）等。

肯定句直接使用“主语 + 谓语 + 介词 + 动名词”，否定形式在动名词前加 not，例如 She insisted on not telling anyone. 疑问句将助动词或 be 动词提前，动名词部分保持不变，例如 Are you interested in learning French? 在书面语和口语中，该结构都极为常见，是表达态度、原因、方式、时间关系等的重要手段。

初中阶段通常只要求掌握 be good at、be interested in、thank you for、what about 等固定短语后接动名词。高中阶段则进一步拓展到 look forward to、be used to、devote oneself to、object to、in addition to、be accustomed to 等短语，其中 to 是介词而非不定式符号，后面必须接动名词。此外，高中还要求能在复杂句中识别“介词 + 动名词”作状语或定语的情况，例如 On hearing the news, she burst into tears.

与动词不定式相比，动名词作介词宾语是唯一正确形式。很多学生受“to + 动词原形”思维定式影响，在 look forward to、be used to 等结构后误用动词原形。另一个易错点是混淆现在分词和动名词：作介词宾语的是动名词，具有名词性质；而现在分词起形容词或副词作用，例如 a sleeping bag 中的 sleeping 是现在分词作定语，不是介词宾语。

易错点一：在介词后使用不定式，如 interested in to hike，这是典型错误。易错点二：把 look forward to、be used to 中的 to 误认为不定式符号，后接动词原形。易错点三：动名词的否定形式 not 位置错误，应放在动名词之前，如 without saying 的否定是 without not saying 而非 not without saying。易错点四：在固定短语中介词遗漏，例如 be fond of 后直接接动词原形。
forms: 介词 + 动名词（V-ing）：interested in hiking / good at swimming / afraid of flying
be + 形容词 + 介词 + 动名词：be interested in doing / be good at doing / be fond of doing
动词 + 介词 + 动名词：look forward to meeting / insist on going / think about changing
介词 + not + 动名词（否定）：without saying goodbye / for not finishing homework / about not telling the truth
介词 + 动名词短语作状语：On arriving home, he turned on the TV. / After finishing the work, she left.
固定短语中的介词 + 动名词：in addition to studying / be used to getting up early / devote oneself to helping others
notes: 高考书面表达中，look forward to、be used to、object to、devote oneself to 等短语中的 to 是介词，后面必须接动名词，不能接动词原形。
动名词的否定形式是 not + V-ing，放在介词之后，例如 He was punished for not obeying the rules. 不要写成 not for obeying。
在语域较高的书面语中，介词 + 动名词常作状语置于句首，如 On seeing the result, she sighed. 注意此时动名词的逻辑主语应与主句主语一致。
区分动名词与现在分词：作介词宾语的一定是动名词，具有名词功能；现在分词则起修饰作用，例如 a walking stick 中的 walking 不是介词宾语。
高考语法填空常考“介词 + 动名词”的搭配，尤其是 to 作介词的短语，如 be accustomed to、in addition to、when it comes to 等，后面必须用 V-ing。
